analyzed_vuln.description: In the XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE branch, this function moves fallback result nodes out of the xi:include subtree with xmlAddPrevSibling, then unlinks and frees the include node. It does not reconcile or copy namespace bindings for the moved nodes. A moved fallback descendant can retain node->ns pointing at a namespace declaration owned by the include node's nsDef; xmlFreeNode(cur) frees that declaration, leaving the surviving replacement node with a dangling namespace pointer. Serialization later reads cur->ns->prefix in xmlNodeDumpOutputInternal, causing the heap-use-after-free.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The parser options must enable XInclude processing and XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE (the PoV's option word does), and parsing must produce an xi:include whose namespace declaration is owned by the include element. Loading its href must fail so a non-empty xi:fallback is selected, with a replacement descendant using the inherited namespace binding from the include element (as the PoV's xi:i does; recovery options permit the truncated markup). XInclude processing moves that descendant before the include and frees the include/nsDef; subsequent document serialization dereferences the dangling replacement node->ns pointer.

args: Analyze the namespace lifetime bug in xmlXIncludeIncludeNode in libxml2/xinclude.c around line 2288. What existing libxml2 namespace reconciliation/copying patterns should be used when XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE moves fallback children before an xi:include and then frees the include? Identify a minimal root-cause fix and relevant edge cases (node namespaces and attribute namespaces, nested descendants, allocation failure).

The ASan report shows xmlXIncludeIncludeNode moving fallback result nodes with xmlAddPrevSibling and then freeing the xi:include. A surviving fallback descendant has node->ns pointing into the include element's nsDef, which xmlFreeNode frees; serialization later reads the dangling prefix. This occurs under XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE after failed href loading and fallback selection. I am inspecting the exact branch and looking for established namespace reconciliation helpers in xinclude.c and elsewhere. The desired patch must preserve namespace semantics for all moved subtree descendants and namespaced attributes, not merely clear the crashing pointer.
